notes: kb/Work PB5373 class 1, recorded 2026-11-14 (wave 20262028 A). §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR7: "If the MCS attempts to schedule a program lacking an INITIAL clause, the results are undefined." The rule's own text declares the result undefined, so it closes on the mechanical arm undefined-in-rule (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 8, DRV-1985-GR-XIV.2.2.4-7, signed claude: 2026-11-12). WiseOwl's behaviour is determinate all the same: CommunicationEmitter.EmitActivation asks MessageControlSession.InitialArea for the scheduling names only for a CD that carries INITIAL, so a scheduled program with none runs as any other program and the scheduling message stays queued. No test: a rule whose result is undefined has no expected value.

next.reason: 1985: "If the MCS attempts to schedule a program lacking an INITIAL clause, the results are undefined."; 2023: "No communication description entry, MCS or CD INITIAL clause; no candidate covers the feature". The 2023 standard lacks the communication module. No candidate covers the CD entry or MCS scheduling, so the rule is dropped with the feature.
